pairs: 1985 (same year as Back to the Future!)
Astoria, Oregon, a real coast town
story: Mikey and his friends call themselves the Goonies, and their whole neighborhood is about to be bulldozed unless someone finds a miracle. In the attic, Mikey discovers an old map leading to the treasure of the pirate One-Eyed Willy. With a family of crooks called the Fratellis hot on their trail, the Goonies brave booby-trapped tunnels to save their homes.
trivia_title: Hey you guys! Did you know...
trivia: The pirate ship was built FULL SIZE and the kids were not allowed to see it before filming, so their amazed faces are their first real look.
After the movie, nobody would take the ship, so it was scrapped.
Data is played by Ke Huy Quan. In 2023 he won an Oscar, almost 40 years after this movie.
Mikey is Sean Astin. He grew up to play Samwise in The Lord of the Rings.
numbers: Mikey, Brand, Chunk, Mouth, Data, Andy and Stef
to build One-Eyed Willy's pirate ship at full size
to make the whole movie in 1985
scenes: The map that starts everything. Mikey lines up the doubloon with the coastline to find the way in.
The underground river. Most of the caves were giant sets built inside a warehouse.
One-Eyed Willy's treasure. Watch what Mikey saves in his marble bag at the very end.
questions: The Goonies keep going into danger instead of telling their parents. Brave or foolish? Make your case.
Mikey talks to One-Eyed Willy like an old friend. What does Willy mean to Mikey?
Mikey keeps believing when everyone else wants to quit. When have YOU kept going after everyone said it was impossible?
